OWNER ROUTING: accepted exactly as sequenced. I created two separate StoryAtlas-local beads, with foreign ids recorded only as notes and no cross-store dependency edges.

- bd-01M16KD7WBWKTQC6CENE9V67Q0: expose and exercise both existing ZoomLevel axes, preserving Address through compiled placements. It starts after L1(b) releases AppCompiler.
- bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT: story/recall split workspace as a distinct design workstream, explicitly gated before recall-text rendering by the provider trace and privacy witness.

The semantic-zoom bead will not wait on the recall workstream. The current three buttons and Hidden-only artifacts remain labelled tracer until the second axis moves in a real artifact and the conservation scenario passes.
